rules: A capability is classified by repository evidence, never by the existence of a name.
MOCK_ONLY means the capability has code and tests but its behaviour is templated or faked.
CONTRACT_ONLY means it is specified in a merged or proposed contract with no implementation.
PARTIAL means a real mechanism exists but does not satisfy the capability as defined.
PR #28 is NON-CANONICAL and never counts toward a canonical-main classification.

capabilities.evidence: No Goal entity on main. `projects` carries title/summary, which are not acceptance criteria or constraints. Contract in planning-and-plan-revision-model.md section 2.
ProjectTeamMembership has 0 occurrences on main. Contract in actor-principal-and-team-model.md section 4.

ActorPrincipal: 0 occurrences on main (principal_type 0, ProjectTeamMembership 0). The NAME principal_id is NOT free: it already exists as Actor.principal_id in the task/authorization identity domain, 25 occurrences across 7 files under apps/ shared/ agents/ services/ migrations/, and drives two-person control in authorization_policy.py. That Actor is an authorization subject, not a team member -- it carries no principal_type, no autonomous agent functional role and no ProjectTeamMembership, so it does not establish AT-D02. Identity is otherwise fragmented across actor_ref strings, X-Task-Actor headers, agent service names and created_by_agent columns.

shared/sdk/agent_discussion: REVIEW_MODES = (deterministic_template, llm_assisted_disabled, human_review) has no live mode; contribution_templates.py holds hard-coded role strings authored by a single agent (design-review-agent).
CONTRIBUTION_TYPES includes recommendation/architecture_option but there is no proposal entity, no author-vs-challenger relationship and no second participant.

design_review_decisions and project_review_gates exist as real tables, but they are produced by one deterministic reviewer, not by a team, and there is no TeamDecision entity with options_considered / dissent_summary.

shared/sdk/project_planning/task_graph.py contains _FASTAPI_TODO_MILESTONES (7), _FASTAPI_TODO_WORK_ITEMS (9) and _FASTAPI_TODO_DEPENDENCIES (11) as Python literals. ENABLE_PROJECT_PLANNER_REAL_LLM defaults false.
plan_revision / PlanRevision: 0 occurrences on main. project_graph_snapshots stores snapshots but carries no revision reason, supersession link or diff.

shared/sdk/work_items/dispatcher.py resolves a target from infra/delivery/work-item-dispatch-policy.yaml -- a static workType-to-agent lookup. Real mechanism, not capability-based, and ENABLE_PROJECT_WORK_ITEM_DISPATCH defaults false.
0 recipient/addressing fields in shared/. StreamAgent input_stream and output_stream are compile-time class attributes; no agent can choose a recipient.

The NAME handoff is NOT free: 77 case-insensitive occurrences across 14 files under apps/ shared/ agents/ services/ migrations/, all in the legacy delivery_package domain -- HandoffSummary (11) declared in shared/sdk/delivery_package/models.py, handoff_summar* (24), handoff_id (2), plus a notification topic filter and a metrics counter. Those are delivery-package DOCUMENT SECTIONS: no from/to principal, no ownership field, no acceptance state, no transfer verb. The autonomous agent work-transfer primitive is absent: recipient_principal_id, assigned_to_agent, reassign, work_transfer, ownership_transfer, owner_principal_id and transfer_ownership are 0 occurrences each. Legacy delivery handoff_summaries do NOT implement autonomous team Handoff.

shared/sdk/workspace_operator/command_runner.py runs subprocess with shell=False and ALLOWED_MODULES; code_generator.py writes real files under a path allowlist with diffs, change-type and secret validation.

The writer is real; the content is a deterministic FastAPI Todo template (fastapi_todo_generator.py). llm_planner.py exists but ENABLE_LLM_ASSISTED_PLANNING defaults false and the only real provider is plan-only.
shared/sdk/workspace_operator/test_runner.py run_pytest is invoked by runner.py; results are recorded in workspace_test_runs with command, exit code and output summary.
qa-agent imports neither subprocess nor pytest; it evaluates static rules (shared/sdk/qa/rules.py) producing findings. Real evidence model, but verification is not test-driven.

QA findings carry an auto_fixable flag and CodeAutoFixAgent handles exactly three hard-coded buckets (missing generated test file, PR draft sections, syntax error). Anything else is refused to blocked_for_human_review.
A genuine fix-then-revalidate loop exists (autofix republishes to stream.qa and QA bumps auto_fix_attempts), but the responsible agent is hard-coded and DebugAttempt has 0 occurrences.
StreamAgent._handle_failure republishes with with_incremented_retry and dead-letters on exhaustion. This is infrastructure retry and is explicitly NOT autonomous debugging (INV-06).
publish_dead_letter plus stream.deadletter, retry-scheduler app and clarification outbox relay.
The orchestrator LangGraph is linear (intake -> requirement -> policy -> approval -> audit -> dispatch -> END) with no conditional edges and no back-edge.
Legacy delivery_packages (migration 021) with human_acceptance_status is implemented. The 66D DeliverySubmission aggregate is contract-only on main.
DeliverySubmission and ProductOwnerDecision appear on main only in verifiers, tests and docs. The sole implementation is PR #28, which is NON-CANONICAL and HELD.
X-Task-Actor / X-Task-Role headers are self-asserted. ADMIN_CONSOLE_OIDC_ENABLED and ADMIN_CONSOLE_PRODUCTION_AUTH_ENABLED default false. Verified identity is ARCH1-G08, owned by RA-2.

Workflow state, task_messages, artifact refs and decision history are real but task- or project-scoped. There is no cross-task shared team context. No embedding, vector store or retrieval dependency exists.
Deliberately deferred by AT-M1. Shared team context is relational (Goal, Team, Thread, Decision, PlanRevision, WorkItem, Artifact, RunEvidence) until a cross-project or semantic need exists.
17 SDK files across shared/sdk/audit and shared/sdk/audit_integrity, HMAC chaining, integrity verification runs and repair tooling.
approval-engine app plus approval_policy_api.py (922 lines) and shared/sdk/approval_policy.
shared/sdk/secrets provider (392 lines) and secrets_foundation with reference-only handling and redaction.
26 compose services, 20 Dockerfiles and 43 Kubernetes files are real. infra/helm, infra/argocd and infra/vault contain only .gitkeep. .github/workflows does not exist -- there is no CI.
RealLLMPlanOnlyProvider makes genuine httpx calls to OpenAI/Anthropic endpoints, but it is plan-only, ENABLE_REAL_LLM_NETWORK_CALL defaults false, and no LLM SDK is declared in requirements.txt.
